fixed_invariants: Every competitor retains authority, privacy, rights, semantic-loss disclosure, accounting and responsive Stop. Unsafe variants are negative controls, not competitors.

recommendations.candidate_and_admissible_competitor: Shared artifact/derivation graph versus qualified raw pass-through with the same mandatory provenance/loss/rights manifest
recommendations.decisive_falsifier: Any transform loses a source/recipient/authority binding, or same bytes cross domains through equality lookup; F01/F12

recommendations.candidate_and_admissible_competitor: Task-sensitive structured normalization versus raw route-native handling/manual extraction
recommendations.decisive_falsifier: Required event/cell/layout relation omitted or wrong source location; F01/F03
recommendations.nonproof: Best extraction engine or general accuracy

recommendations.candidate_and_admissible_competitor: Per-dimension loss vector versus task-specific structured loss checklist attached to a summary
recommendations.decisive_falsifier: Loss/unknown omitted, confidence treated as proof, or a descendant upgrades trust; F03/F12

recommendations.candidate_and_admissible_competitor: Maintained descriptors versus fresh authorized deterministic capability discovery before each admission, both fail-closed
recommendations.decisive_falsifier: Conflict widens dispatch, hidden fallback occurs, or refusal claims no effect after upload; F02/F14
recommendations.nonproof: Account entitlement or all route coverage

recommendations.candidate_and_admissible_competitor: Separate attribution/settlement projections versus one tagged evidence relation with independently typed quantity and settlement views
recommendations.decisive_falsifier: Null becomes zero, helper vanishes, cumulative receipt doubles cost or reservation becomes refund; F07/F08

recommendations.candidate_and_admissible_competitor: Explicit eligible local OCR/ASR where justified versus approved route processing/manual text
recommendations.decisive_falsifier: Local path egresses, lacks offline dependency or loses matched-quality cost/latency comparison; F04/F15
recommendations.nonproof: Local accuracy, determinism or lower cost

recommendations.candidate_and_admissible_competitor: Graph-propagated retention/rights versus per-artifact rights registry with complete copy inventory and query-time revocation checks
recommendations.decisive_falsifier: Thumbnail/embedding survives forbidden reuse, revoked source rehydrates, offline deletion claimed complete; F13
recommendations.nonproof: Remote physical erasure or legal clearance

recommendations.candidate_and_admissible_competitor: Locally materialized exact payload versus immutable provider-file reference with independently evidenced content identity and current recipient authorization
recommendations.decisive_falsifier: Swapped bytes, redirect, raw-for-thumbnail or revoked-recipient upload proceeds; F05/F08
recommendations.nonproof: Prevention of prior disclosure or all side channels

recommendations.candidate_and_admissible_competitor: Per-job isolated parse workers versus a bounded mature parser inside a separately qualified reusable sandboxed media service
recommendations.decisive_falsifier: Boundary unavailable yet parse occurs, parser network/exec escapes or partial output becomes complete; F06/F11

recommendations.candidate_and_admissible_competitor: Reference-preserving compaction versus retained full raw context plus the same control capsule and rights checks
recommendations.decisive_falsifier: Missing/deleted evidence silently recreated or stale rights reused; F13

recommendations.candidate_and_admissible_competitor: Segmented media receipts versus bounded monolithic job with separate responsive control and honest partial-settlement receipts
recommendations.decisive_falsifier: Stop blocks behind media, post-fence segment starts, or transport exit claims rollback; F08/F11
recommendations.nonproof: Bounded real-host latency or remote rollback

recommendations.candidate_and_admissible_competitor: Text-first projection plus opt-in previews versus preview-first activated viewer with equivalent accessible text and control path
recommendations.decisive_falsifier: Canonical record lost, untrusted escape executes, rendering corrupts controls or view owns work; F09/F11

recommendations.candidate_and_admissible_competitor: Attributed short/long/timed descriptions versus user-authored accessible transcripts/descriptions plus authorized source inspection
recommendations.decisive_falsifier: Missing essential nonvisual information is labeled complete, or preview opening launches hidden inference; F09/F10/F14
recommendations.nonproof: Caption accuracy or all disability needs

recommendations.candidate_and_admissible_competitor: Separate generated candidates/versioned exports versus immutable export bundle with shared operation provenance and equivalent candidate/rights labels
recommendations.decisive_falsifier: Generated output becomes verified evidence by receipt, rights bypassed or production cost omitted; F10
